name: 21793 · Walkersville, MD
findings: ZIP 21793 (Walkersville) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21793 (Walkersville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
